title: Group parking facilities within plan review sites
previewText: For the purposes of this Chapter, no accessory group parking facility for non-residential uses shall be permitted anywhere on a plan review site, or any zoning lot that contained one or more acres on November 2, 2023, except as set forth in Sections 107-51 (Certification of Certain Plan Review Sites) or 107-68 (Modification of Group Parking Regulations).
